Any risky asset that I want to invest in has to meet all five elements of a five star screen... the first thing that I want for a risky asset is I want a risky asset that where there's a good story as to why it should have a risk premium... The next one is I want to be able to estimate that risk premium... The third screen is I want to own this asset, but I don't want to have to take a lot of idiosyncratic risk... The last two parts of the screen are that I want it to be very liquid and kind of transparent. And I want it to have low fees and tax efficiency.
